cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our shared-effort rule counts hosting, so yes, I'll host Christmas. You can roast the potatoes; I taught you that before you could reach the top shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hosting is my share under the rule. I'll gladly oversee yours. You've got the potatoes crisp at last; don't crowd the tray now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You won't even chop the carrots?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Teaching counts as effort too, so yes, I'll stand beside you and supervise the chopping. Use the grip I showed you.
